one_liner: CRM built for Google Workspace teams; public Developer API for CRM objects and webhooks.
access_notes: API keys are self-serve for admins on eligible plans; OAuth2 requires app registration via partners@copper.com.
mcp_notes: Announced by Copper; beta “coming soon” to Claude, launching November 2026. https://www.copper.com/mcp?utm_source=openai
blocker_notes: Pro/Business plan required for ongoing API use; OAuth client registration requires contacting partners@copper.com.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0. API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.
To register your application, contact us (partners@copper.com)… You will receive two credentials, client_id and client_secret…
Available on our trial, professional and business plan
Webhooks allow systems… receive near real-time notification… You may have up to 100 active subscriptions per account… Our notifications… are fired at most once per event, and we do not retry them.
In the Schema field, click Import from URL and paste this link: https://developer.copper.com/v1/openapi.json
